fullText.simplified:
十二、道歉

    许仙的姐姐和姐夫带着一个小箱子来见白素贞。
    白素贞问：“你们见我，是有什么事吗？”
    姐姐不知道怎么开口，说：“我们……我们想给许仙提亲，不知道你愿不愿意？”
    “啊？”白素贞的脸红了，没有说话。
    姐姐把小箱子打开，里面全是钱，她说：“这是我们家全部的钱。我们愿意把它送给白姑娘。我们知道白姑娘是好人家的姑娘，不会因为钱结婚，我们带这些钱来，是想告诉白姑娘，虽然我们没有多少钱，但我们是真心的，愿意把全部的东西都给你。”
    “这……”白素贞不说话了。
    姐夫见白素贞不说话，就马上说：“我们不太会说话，弟弟也不会说话，但他是个好人。第一次见他这么喜欢一个姑娘，我们想帮帮他，所以就来了。我们没有别的意思，就是希望你们在一起。”
    白素贞把小箱子关上了，她说：“我知道许公子是好人，经常听他说起你们，我也知道你们是好人。你们的心意我已经知道了，但这么多的钱我不能收，请带回去吧。”
    “白姑娘，你生气了？”姐姐着急地问。
    “没有。”
    “真的没生气？”
    “真的没有。”白素贞笑着说。
    姐姐和姐夫带着钱箱离开了。他们回到家，心里还是很担心。
    “怎么办，我们好像做错事了。”姐姐说。
    姐夫也没有办法，说：“晚上等弟弟回来了，和他说一说。”
    姐姐不知道怎么办，一直在等许仙。直到晚上，许仙才回来。姐姐马上把事情和他说了，许仙一听就急了：“姐！你怎么能这样做？”
    “我知道错了，现在怎么办？”姐姐急得快哭了。
    许仙见姐姐快哭了，只好说：“我先去给白姑娘道歉。她是个好人，你不要太担心。”
    许仙一路跑来见白素贞。到了家门口，却不敢敲门。
    白素贞却好像知道他来了。她打开门，笑着说：“为什么不敲门呢？”
    许仙站着没有动，说：“对不起。”
    “你又没做错事，为什么说对不起？”
    “我是来给我姐姐和姐夫道歉的。”
    “他们也没有做错事，不用道歉。”
    “你不生气吗？”
    “不生气，我知道他们是为了你好。”
    “谢谢你，白姑娘。”
    “不用谢。现在你的话说完了吗，可以进来了吗？”
    “没有。我还有一句话想问。”
    “什么话？”
    “你……愿意和我在一起吗？”
    白素贞眼里闪着光，她没有回答。
    “我的意思是结婚，你愿意和我结婚吗？”许仙问。
    白素贞眼里的光更亮了，她还是没有说话，但她点了点头。
    许仙大叫一声，高兴得跳了起来。
fullText.traditional:
十二、道歉

    許仙的姐姐和姐夫帶著一個小箱子來見白素貞。
    白素貞問：“你們見我，是有什麼事嗎？”
    姐姐不知道怎麼開口，說：“我們……我們想給許仙提親，不知道你願不願意？”
    “啊？”白素貞的臉紅了，沒有說話。
    姐姐把小箱子打開，裡面全是錢，她說：“這是我們家全部的錢。我們願意把它送給白姑娘。我們知道白姑娘是好人家的姑娘，不會因為錢結婚，我們帶這些錢來，是想告訴白姑娘，雖然我們沒有多少錢，但我們是真心的，願意把全部的東西都給你。”
    “這……”白素貞不說話了。
    姐夫見白素貞不說話，就馬上說：“我們不太會說話，弟弟也不會說話，但他是個好人。第一次見他這麼喜歡一個姑娘，我們想幫幫他，所以就來了。我們沒有別的意思，就是希望你們在一起。”
    白素貞把小箱子關上了，她說：“我知道許公子是好人，經常聽他說起你們，我也知道你們是好人。你們的心意我已經知道了，但這麼多的錢我不能收，請帶回去吧。”
    “白姑娘，你生氣了？”姐姐著急地問。
    “沒有。”
    “真的沒生氣？”
    “真的沒有。”白素貞笑著說。
    姐姐和姐夫帶著錢箱離開了。他們回到家，心裡還是很擔心。
    “怎麼辦，我們好像做錯事了。”姐姐說。
    姐夫也沒有辦法，說：“晚上等弟弟回來了，和他說一說。”
    姐姐不知道怎麼辦，一直在等許仙。直到晚上，許仙才回來。姐姐馬上把事情和他說了，許仙一聽就急了：“姐！你怎麼能這樣做？”
    “我知道錯了，現在怎麼辦？”姐姐急得快哭了。
    許仙見姐姐快哭了，只好說：“我先去給白姑娘道歉。她是個好人，你不要太擔心。”
    許仙一路跑來見白素貞。到了家門口，卻不敢敲門。
    白素貞卻好像知道他來了。她打開門，笑著說：“為什麼不敲門呢？”
    許仙站著沒有動，說：“對不起。”
    “你又沒做錯事，為什麼說對不起？”
    “我是來給我姐姐和姐夫道歉的。”
    “他們也沒有做錯事，不用道歉。”
    “你不生氣嗎？”
    “不生氣，我知道他們是為了你好。”
    “謝謝你，白姑娘。”
    “不用謝。現在你的話說完了嗎，可以進來了嗎？”
    “沒有。我還有一句話想問。”
    “什麼話？”
    “你……願意和我在一起嗎？”
    白素貞眼裡閃著光，她沒有回答。
    “我的意思是結婚，你願意和我結婚嗎？”許仙問。
    白素貞眼裡的光更亮了，她還是沒有說話，但她點了點頭。
    許仙大叫一聲，高興得跳了起來。

sentences.english: “Thank you, Miss Bai.”

sentences.simplified: “不用谢。现在你的话说完了吗，可以进来了吗？”
sentences.traditional: “不用謝。現在你的話說完了嗎，可以進來了嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: bú yòng xiè xiàn zài nǐ de huà shuō wán le ma kě yǐ jìn lái le ma
sentences.english: “You’re welcome. Are you done talking now? Can you come in?”

sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu wǒ hái yǒu yí jù huà xiǎng wèn
sentences.english: “No, I still have one more thing to ask.”

sentences.pinyin: shén me huà
sentences.english: “What is it?”

sentences.pinyin: nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ zài yì qǐ ma
sentences.english: “Will you … be with me?”

sentences.traditional: 白素貞眼裡閃著光，她沒有回答。

sentences.english: Bai Suzhen’s eyes sparkled, but she did not answer.

sentences.simplified: “我的意思是结婚，你愿意和我结婚吗？”许仙问。
sentences.traditional: “我的意思是結婚，你願意和我結婚嗎？”許仙問。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ de yì si shì jié hūn nǐ yuàn yì hé wǒ jié hūn ma xǔ xiān wèn
sentences.english: “What I mean is getting married. Will you marry me?” Xu Xian asked.

sentences.english: The light in Bai Suzhen’s eyes sparkled even brighter. She still didn’t say anything, but she nodded.

sentences.traditional: 許仙大叫一聲，高興得跳了起來。

sentence_translations: 12. Apology
Xu Xian’s older sister and brother-in-law came to see Bai Suzhen carrying a small box.
Bai Suzhen asked, “Did you come to see me about something?”
The older sister didn’t know how to start, and said, ..
.. “We … we want to propose marriage on behalf of Xu Xian, and we don’t know if you are willing?”
“Huh?” Bai Suzhen blushed and didn’t say anything.
The older sister opened the small box, and it was full of money.
She said, “This is all the money our family has. We are willing to give it to Miss Bai.
We know that Miss Bai is a girl from a good family and wouldn’t marry for money.
We brought this money to show Miss Bai that although we don’t have much money, we are sincere and willing to give you everything.”
“This …” Bai Suzhen fell silent.
The brother-in-law saw that Bai Suzhen wasn’t saying anything, so he immediately said, ..
.. “We are not very good with words, and neither is my younger brother, but he is a good person.
This is the first time we’ve seen him like a girl so much, so we wanted to help him, and that’s why we’re here.
We have no other intentions. We just hope you two can be together.”
Bai Suzhen closed the small box and said, “I know Young Master Xu is a good person, and I often hear him talk about you both.
I also know you are good people. I understand your good intentions, but I cannot accept so much money. Please take it back.”
“Miss Bai, are you angry?” the older sister asked anxiously.
“No.”
“You’re really not angry?”
“I’m really not,” Bai Suzhen said with a smile.
The older sister and brother-in-law left with the box of money. They returned home, still feeling very worried.
“What should we do? It seems like we’ve done something wrong,” the older sister said.
The brother-in-law couldn’t do anything either, and said, “Let’s wait for our younger brother to come back tonight and talk to him.”
The older sister didn’t know what to do and kept waiting for Xu Xian.
It wasn’t until the evening that Xu Xian returned.
The older sister immediately told him about the situation, and as soon as Xu Xian heard it, he became anxious, ..
.. “Older Sister! How could you do this?”
“I know I made a mistake. What should we do now?” The older sister was so anxious she was about to cry.
Xu Xian saw that his older sister was about to cry, so he had no choice but to say, ..
.. “I’ll go apologize to Miss Bai first. She is a good person, so you don’t need to worry too much.”
Xu Xian ran all the way to see Bai Suzhen. He arrived in front of the house but was too scared to knock.
Yet Bai Suzhen seemed to know that he had come.
She opened the door and said with a smile, “Why didn’t you knock?”
Xu Xian stood there without moving, and said, “I’m sorry.”
“You didn’t do anything wrong. Why are you saying sorry?”
“I am here to apologize on behalf of my older sister and brother-in-law.”
“They didn’t do anything wrong either. There’s no need to apologize.”
“Aren’t you angry?”
“I’m not angry. I know they mean well for you.”
“Thank you, Miss Bai.”
“You’re welcome. Are you done talking now? Can you come in?”
“No, I still have one more thing to ask.”
“What is it?”
“Will you … be with me?”
Bai Suzhen’s eyes sparkled, but she did not answer.
“What I mean is getting married. Will you marry me?” Xu Xian asked.
The light in Bai Suzhen’s eyes sparkled even brighter. She still didn’t say anything, but she nodded.
Xu Xian shouted loudly and jumped up with joy.
